body:
Found: parser only accepted ONE arith operator with a bare State on both sides -- GRAMMAR.md §3.3's own left-associative chain rule couldn't parse, neither could combining two Let-bound values. Fixed: value() loops over (op, primary) pairs; primary() unifies State/VOID/bare-MAGNET. Verified end-to-end: S1 XOR4 S2 XOR4 S3 actually computes correctly through parena build+cc+execution ((1^2)^3=0). 18 tests total, go build/vet/test clean. LO commit f7e11a5.

⚓ ☃
title: Real left-associative arith chains, any primary operand (found and fixed a real gap)
